mods.name: Sky2M
mods.description: Sky2M utilities and Hypixel SkyBlock features.

releases.notes:
## ✨ Added
- **Party Finder helper** – dark red for groups you can't join, green for groups missing your class; optional colours for paid carries, non-PUGs and low class levels. Missing classes and floor shown on every group.
- **Missing Accessories** (`/s2 mp`) – accessories you don't have yet, cheapest MP first, with upgrades, recombs, prices and where to get them.
- **Sack Display** – a panel beside an open sack with each item's amount, price, value and the sack's total.
- **Value Breakdown Panel** – hover an item to see what its value is made of.
- **Custom Wardrobe** – the Wardrobe as cards, with themes, favourites and page tabs.
- **Import settings from other mods** (`/s2 import`) – 14 mods, 525 settings.
- **Clip sharing** – upload clips and watch them in game.
- **Fonts** – Inter, your own .ttf or font resource packs.
- **Garden** – visitor accept/refuse glow, Pest Plot Borders, click shopping list items to open the Bazaar, item icons in the shopping list, Oct 27 update support (10-visitor queue), Harvest Feast crop HUD, Garden keybinds, Garden drop animations.
- **Chat** – MVP++ emotes for everyone, unlimited chat history, Tab complete for names and subcommands, pet rarity in drops, compact Bestiary, SkyBlock XP in chat, Sky Mall & Lottery filter everywhere.
- **Other** – Chocolate Factory Stats, Hotspot Radar guesser, Cocoon Label, Items on Ground prices while slayering, sold/expired auction highlights, skill level as stack size, Session XP, Edit HUDs key, per-item prices in profit trackers, Add-ons category.

## 🔧 Changed
- Rarity backgrounds in the Inventory HUD, overflow pet levels in /pv, Custom Wardrobe toggle button.
- `/s2 featuresearch` understands descriptions, not just names.
- Visitor Timer works with any queue size; new Garden plot border look.
- RNG HUD moved to Misc; Cocoon Alert and chat profile icons on by default.
- Item Pickup Log reworked; Fishing Profit only shows while fishing.
- Sky2M screens fit Auto GUI scale better and match the settings menu.
- Other mods' and people's names removed from setting names (some options renamed).
- Lots of smaller tweaks: `/s2 calc` takes x, cleaner /pv armour page, right-click an item for its usages, and more.

## 🗑️ Removed
- **Cross-Mod Bridge** – Sky2M no longer connects or signs in to Odin's, NoammAddons' or Devonian's party sockets.
- Inquisitor Gamble, slayer Phase Timer, RNG Drop Title, Big Drop Animation, built-in Generic Man model.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **/s2 protect** – protected items now work in the Wardrobe, toolkits, Abiphone, Hex, Kat, Composter, Gemstone Grinder, Fossil Excavator, Runic Pedestal, fusion and other menus you put items into.
- **Item Pickup Log** – Wardrobe swaps no longer show as +1/-1; pets and books aren't merged into one line.
- **Dungeons** – map player heads stacking or in the wrong spot; broken split times.
- **Slayer** – profit tracking (quest cost, tier, auto-slayer fees); boss HUD losing your boss.
- **Item value** – Kuudra armour and fishing rods; enchant colouring on tools.
- Plus: friends missing from Tab complete, Keep Terrain Loaded during contests, Skill ETA at overflow, Mouse Lock, compacted items in profit trackers, Sea Creature Tracker over /storage, and more.
